Eye of the Storm'' |writer=[[Charles Soule]]{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/96252/star_wars_the_high_republic_-_eye_of_the_storm_2022_1|text=Star Wars: The High Republic - Eye of the Storm (2022) #1}} |penciller=[[Guillermo Sanna]] |inker=Guillermo Sanna |letterer=[[Ariana Maher]] |colorist=*[[Jim Campbell]] (1-2) *[[Antonio Fabela]]{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/96253/star_wars_the_high_republic_-_eye_of_the_storm_2022_2|text=Star Wars: The High Republic - Eye of the Storm (2022) #2}} (2) |cover artist=[[Ryan Brown]] |editor=[[Danny Khazem]] |publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] |start date=[[January 12]] [[2022]]{{WebCite|url=https://www.gamesradar.com/marvel-comics-january-2022-solicitations|text=January 2022 Marvel Comics revealed|work=Newsarama|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/8zscl}} |end date=[[March 2]], 2022 |schedule= |format=Miniseries |issues=2 |timeline=[[230 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars: The High Republic: Eye of the Storm'' to [[230 BBY]]. |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: The High Republic: Eye of the Storm''''' is a comic miniseries written by [[Charles Soule]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project. It focuses on the character [[Marchion Ro]] and his backstory, which Soule described as "complicated." {{Comics-stub}}
